baseline_models.focus_anchor: The negated genitive construction بقول كاهن and the following قليلا ما تذكرون.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse rejects a proposed provenance for articulated speech: the discourse is not owned or generated by a reporter who conjectures about hidden matters. The scarcity clause diagnoses why that bad source-label remains available: recall is too slight to recognize the discourse as reminder rather than occult report.

activation_trace.role: Articulated speech supplies the object whose provenance the negation contests.
Conjectural reporting of hidden matters supplies the rejected source-type.
Fewness and rarity scale the audience's remembering down rather than the discourse itself.
Bringing something back to mind makes failed recognition the response problem.

changed_reading.before: A bare denial that the words are a soothsayer's, followed by a generic rebuke.
changed_reading.after: A provenance correction: conjectural hidden-reporting is the wrong account of this speech, and scarce recall permits the misattribution.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: قول at word 2 and تذكرون at word 6, linked through قليلا.
baseline_models.mechanism: Speech leaves the tongue as an utterance, while remembrance brings what was heard into the heart and can return it to the tongue as mention. The verse therefore measures a failed conversion from abundant address to retrievable, repeatable reminder; the scarcity belongs to uptake, not to available speech.

activation_trace.role: Uttered speech supplies the incoming side of the reception circuit.
Heart-recall supplies the inward retention that should follow hearing.
Mention on the tongue supplies the possible outward return of what has been retained.
Fewness marks the low yield of that speech-to-memory conversion.

changed_reading.after: The addressed speech is not becoming durable inward recall or renewed mention; reception has a low mnemonic yield.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ownership relation in قول كاهن, with branch senses of both قول and كاهن extending beyond ordinary speech and divination.
baseline_models.mechanism: A qawl may operate as a force-bearing pronouncement, while a kahin may be an appointed agent who manages another's affair. On this branch, the negation refuses an administrative model in which an intermediary owns the operative word or independently conducts the matter; scarce remembering obscures the true commission behind the voice.

activation_trace.role: A titled chief whose word has force supplies an operative rather than merely descriptive speech-image.
The agent managing another's affairs supplies the rejected intermediary-ownership model.
Recall is assigned the task of recovering whose commission the speaking voice actually bears.

changed_reading.before: Kahin contributes only the familiar category of occult diviner.
changed_reading.after: The denied label also carries a live agency question: this is not the independently operative word of a human manager or proxy.

context_deltas.mechanism: An earlier act of denial is followed by a stated conversion of preserved event into reminder, then by an ear that accepts the heard material and a heart that contains its meaning. Focus 69:42 becomes the failure point of that designed chain: the audience repeats source-denial because the reminder crosses the ear but is scarcely contained as recall.

activation_trace.role: Attributing a thing or its bearer to falsehood supplies the recurrent rejection that memory should interrupt.
A thing made into a reminder supplies the intended mnemonic function of the preserved account.
Containing meaning in the heart supplies the internal retention stage missing at the focus.
Listening and accepting what is heard supplies the receptive gateway into retention.
The focus verb anchors the failed final stage as scarce bringing-to-mind.

A live alternative is that 69:12 and 69:42 share only a broad admonitory theme, not a staged mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Little remembering is an isolated mental defect.
changed_reading.after: It is the low-output end of a failed reception system: preserved sign becomes heard reminder but is not durably contained, so denial recurs.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context first presents persons openly and removes concealment, then solemnly spans what is seen and what is not seen. Against that field, the kahin is not rejected because the discourse lacks access to the unseen; the rejected mechanism is proprietary conjecture about hidden reports. The discourse instead addresses both fields while moving concealment toward public disclosure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context positively calls the discourse a messenger's qawl, negatively calls it a kahin's qawl, and then specifies delivered descent from the Lord. The repeated construction distinguishes relay-level attribution from origin-level ownership: a messenger voices what is sent, whereas the rejected kahin model makes the intermediary the operative source or manager.

changed_reading.before: The verse merely excludes one human profession as author.

changed_reading.before: Scarce remembering is an interchangeable rhetorical refrain.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's scarce act of remembering is followed by the declaration that the discourse itself is a reminder for those who place themselves in protection. Remembering therefore becomes operational rather than merely cognitive: retained admonition is what can be interposed between the self and harm.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence names active falsehood-attribution, then joins the discourse to regret among coverers. The branch images make a temporal reversal available: what is covered against recall is eventually stripped of covering and returns as grief over what was missed. Scarce remembering is thus potentially defensive occlusion, not mere weak storage.

changed_reading.after: It may be chosen covering: reminder is kept from view until the cover comes off as belated, painful recognition.

That enclosure gives the kahin denial a precise epistemic opposite: not speech functioning as supposition about hidden reports, but discourse whose claim is fixed to actuality and culminates in certainty.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the sequence of false speaker-labels and false-attribution warnings, the final command supplies a counter-speech act: exonerate and designate the Lord by name. strongest_changes: The reminder/ear/heart sequence turns scarce remembering into a failed reception mechanism that permits denial to recur.
Messenger, descent, Lordship, and false-attribution branches distinguish relay-level voicing from origin-level ownership.
The 69:41-42 parallel separates scarce assent from scarce recognition under the poet and kahin labels.
Protection, covering, uncovering, and regret make remembrance practically protective and its suppression temporally reversible.
The opening and closing truth-certainty frame opposes actuality and settled knowledge to conjectural hidden reporting.
summary.what_was_special: The packet kept several unusual mechanisms live at once: kahin as both occult reporter and managing agent; qawl as utterance, attribution, operative force, and a split-root neighbor of q-l-l; and remembrance as recall, mention, reminder, protection, or even a juridical document. The repeated qawl...qalilan pair and the later seizure of the life-artery generated contained sound-material and bodily readings without displacing the stronger provenance reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The exact one-to-one pairing of poet with assent and kahin with remembrance is inferred from parallelism rather than stated causally.
The carrier-versus-origin distinction may assign more ownership precision to the qawl genitives than grammar alone requires.
The cover-to-uncover-to-regret sequence is a branch-driven temporal inference, not an explicit causal sentence.
The split-root instability, speech-life conduit, and juridical-document readings should remain overlays rather than lexical substitutions.
